info.title: agentic-roslyn-tool
info.description: Splits C# files that declare more than one top-level type into one file per type, so a codebase can turn on StyleCop SA1402. Roslyn Syntax API only, so it does not need a solution that compiles.

commands.name: split-types
commands.description: Split C# files that declare more than one top-level type (SA1402).

options.name: --input
options.description:
A directory to scan, one .cs file, a CSV with a 'file' column,
a text file with one path per line, or '-' to read paths from stdin.

options.name: --repo-root
options.description: Repository root used for git operations. Defaults to the current directory.

options.name: --manifest
options.description:
Path to the plan manifest CSV. Defaults to sa1402-split-manifest.csv beside a list
input, or in --repo-root for a directory or stdin input. Only plan writes it.
Must name a file. renames and content refuse a symbolic link here.

options.name: --report
options.description:
Where renames and content record what they did. Defaults to the manifest path
with .report.csv as its extension. Not accepted with the plan phase.
Replaces a file in the report format. Refuses any other existing file.

options.name: --phase
options.description: Which phase to run. Defaults to plan, which changes no source file.

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Same as --phase plan. Kept for older scripts. Cannot be combined with --phase.

options.name: --json
options.description: Print one JSON report to stdout instead of CSV.

options.name: --require-header
options.description: Require and prepend this file header. Off by default.

options.name: --exclude
options.description: Skip inputs whose path contains this substring. Repeatable.

options.name: --collision-naming
options.description:
Name for two inputs that emit the same file name. file-first, the default,
gives A.Shared.cs. type-first gives Shared.A.cs, which passes SA1649.
The plan records the value; renames and content reuse it when the flag is absent.

options.name: --file-naming
options.description:
SA1649 convention for generic file names. Defaults to stylecop: Foo.cs,
or Foo{T}.cs when a same-name type shares the file. metadata names
them Foo`1.cs. Pass the same value to every phase.

options.name: --help
options.description:
Show help.
Typical workflow. Use one list file and one manifest outside the repository for every step:
1. split-types --input <list> --manifest <csv> --json                    plan; changes no source file
2. split-types --input <list> --manifest <csv> --json --phase renames    git mv only; commit it
3. split-types --input <list> --manifest <csv> --json --phase content    rewrites files; build and test
With --json, nextArgs in the report holds the exact arguments for the next step.
Exit codes: 0 no failures, 1 a file failed, 2 bad command line, 3 the run could not complete.
Exit 0 can still mean nothing happened. Read summary.split, or the summary line.
Standard output carries the data (CSV or JSON); the summary and a Next: line go to standard error.
If the report file cannot be written, its rows go to standard output and the run exits 3.
